decisions.reason: The address autocomplete service builds on the firm's master data and has very low marginal costs, so it meets a modest aspiration and gives no reason for problemistic search.
The Austrian gas grid fee database extends the core database business to a neighbouring market, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product even if uptake is uncertain.
Peak load window determination is a regulatory process service tightly tied to network operator customers and fits the platform strategy, so it likely meets aspirations.
The end-customer tariff database line with several models is close to the firm's core market data offer and probably performs at or above aspiration.
Custom web services support the move toward SaaS and data exchange and reuse existing infrastructure, so dropping them would release few resources.
The postal code lookup is a cheap, standardized web service that complements the database offering, so there is little shortfall to trigger dropping it.
